description: Header file defining the Python bindings and interface for C++ autograd functions in PyTorch, including class definitions, function prototypes, and macros for function registration.

classes.name: THPCppFunction
classes.description: Struct representing a Python object for a C++ autograd function, containing a shared pointer to a Node.

methods.name: CppFunction_pynew
methods.description: Creates a new Python object wrapping a C++ Node constructed with provided arguments.

methods.name: THP_FUNCTION_DEFAULT_METHODS
methods.description: Macro defining default methods for autograd functions.

methods.name: THP_FUNCTION_DEFAULT_PROPERTIES
methods.description: Macro defining default properties for autograd functions.

methods.name: THPCppFunction_next_functions
methods.description: Returns the next functions in the autograd graph.

methods.name: THPCppFunction_metadata
methods.description: Returns metadata for the autograd function.

methods.name: THPCppFunction_requires_grad
methods.description: Checks if the function requires gradient.

methods.name: THPCppFunction_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the function.

methods.name: _initFunctionPyTypeObject
methods.description: Initializes a Python type object for autograd functions.

methods.name: registerFunctionHook
methods.description: Registers a hook for a Node.

methods.name: registerFunctionPreHook
methods.description: Registers a pre-hook for a Node.

methods.name: createForwardFunctionPyTypeObject
methods.description: Creates a Python type object for a forward autograd function.

methods.name: registerCppFunction
methods.description: Registers a C++ function type with its Python type object.

methods.name: functionToPyObject
methods.description: Converts a shared_ptr<Node> to a Python object.

methods.name: THPCppFunction_Check
methods.description: Checks if a Python object is a THPCppFunction.
